Situation Report — Day 27

  • Airstrikes — US/Israeli jets struck Isfahan and Khorramshahr (first pause was violated).
  • Pause announced: Trump declared a SECOND 10‑day pause on strikes targeting Iranian energy infrastructure (deadline: Apr 6, 2026, 20:00 ET). Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating.
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah attacks continue daily. IDF says it has not withdrawn from southern Lebanon. Ongoing exchanges of rocket/missile fire across the border.
  • Iranian counterstrikes: Iran/Hezbollah/Hamas continue missile and rocket strikes against Israel; US/Israel continue airstrikes inside Iran.
  • Strait of Hormuz: Iran permits passage for friendly states (Russia, India, China); warns others and threatens unauthorised crossings. Naval/transit access is now politicised and selective.
  • Diplomacy & NATO: Türkiye urges backing for the US‑Iran deal. Iran accuses NATO of complicity. No major troop deployments reported.
  • Economic/energy: China state refiners may resume Iranian oil purchases. Dubai is mobilising businesses to protect its hub status from regional war impacts.
  • IAEA & inspections: IAEA says nuclear site inspections will occur; timing flexible.
  • Operational note: This is the 2nd formal pause; the first was breached within hours. Tactical patterns show short pauses followed by immediate kinetic responses.
  • 🟢 Good News: A formal 10‑day pause was announced and Pakistan is mediating. IAEA inspections confirmed as planned.
Threat assessment: Volatile — fragile pauses with high risk of renewed escalation.

48.en:
Situation Report — Day 27 (last 48h)

Active strikes/sirens:
  • Ongoing: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iranian targets. Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas continue missile/rocket strikes on Israel. Northern border exchanges continue daily.

Immediate events

  • Trump announced SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes: 10 days (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 8 PM ET). He says pause followed an “Iranian Government request” and talks are “going very well.”
  • Tehran denies direct talks. Pakistan acting as mediator.
  • First pause (Mar 23, five days) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr — precedent raises risk of repeat violation.

Northern Border (Lebanon)

  • Hezbollah firing daily at IDF positions. Cross-border exchanges remain frequent.
  • IDF states it has not withdrawn from southern Lebanon — tensions and skirmishes persist.

Air, Sea, Logistics

  • Iran permits Strait of Hormuz passage selectively: Russia, India, China allowed; others blocked. Creates segmented maritime access and supply routes.
  • Reports: China refiners consider resuming Iranian oil imports — could affect long-term logistics and global energy flows.

Diplomacy & International

  • Pakistan mediating talks. Turkey/NATO actors urging support for a deal; NATO leaders highlighting allied assistance (diplomatic/military posture reporting, no large redeployments public).

Operational context

  • Second pause is fragile — first pause breached quickly. High risk of localized violations and retaliatory strikes.

🟢 Good News

  • IAEA says nuclear site inspections will occur — limited de-escalatory framework for inspections exists.
  • Pakistan mediation underway.
Threat assessment: Escalating

דיפלומטיה ובין-לאומי
